workflow: Verify endpoint/profile/current actor access and enumerate independently authorized parameter identities from the exact native view or command-specific public route stated below; no hidden target substitution.

Form canonical finite native payloads and same-current-revision command candidates from the recipes. Preserve native constructor list order. Domains and illustrative examples remain distinct; embedded elections create no pending decisions.

Apply current identity/recipient/consent disclosure and grant filters before final comparison. Hidden candidates never participate in rank or tie groups. No raw indices, private counts or protected rows are exposed.

Within each fixed numeric kind/variant, use Core-owned StringComparer.Ordinal canonical Command.Fingerprint comparison. Coalesce identical canonical candidates while retaining recipe/axis associations; distinct effective equal keys block qualification.

Assign contiguous zero-based public example ordinals to the resulting ordered authorized candidates, allocate principal-local hc1 IDs, then apply exact native payload/constructor/fingerprint and derived-ID constraints.

Assess the concrete command only through the new pure current assessment. This determines admissibility. Supported currently denied examples require an approved safe assessment; constructor/technical failures remain explicit descriptor/technical limitations, not silently empty native domains.

No ID/rank/candidate-count choice may inspect protected contamination, enemy contribution rows, other-principal receipts, private save/DC/RNG or concealed condition details. No legacy query, resolver copy, replay, RNG, settlement or reservation is used.
commonRecipe.deniedExamples: These recipes enumerate source-supported canonical candidates, including currently denied candidates when the descriptor permits a safe assessment. commonRecipe.pending: No real pending-choice ID is allocated by these ten recipes. Cure, Focused and advancement selections are embedded payload elections. GuidanceChoice belongs to other command families; no per-Hide consumption fact is exposed.
commonRecipe.resourceValues: No request here chooses a resource quantum. Purify selects a whole actual lot, never an invented fraction, minimum positive quantity or portion. Native RP/action/cure costs and future obligations remain assessor facts/descriptors, not new input fields.
